notes: Git attribution is not proof of sole personal authorship or endorsement.
The tui snapshot is origin/ryansquared/openpgp-tui at analysis time, not merged main.
Anchors are exact source substrings. Rule mapping describes supporting evidence, not exhaustive proof of every recommendation.
Imported keyfork-openpgp-card-sequoia code is excluded as evidence of personal Rust style.

evidence.observation: Explicit guide distinguishing borrowed, owned-copy, and consuming APIs, including into_parts and computed seed.
Implementation of documented as_bytes/to_bytes/into_bytes ownership variants.

evidence.anchor: pub const fn new(index: u32, hardened: bool) -> Result<Self>
evidence.observation: Validated domain constructor, FromStr and Display implementations, rustdoc and boundary/roundtrip tests.

evidence.anchor: pub fn chain_push(mut self, index: DerivationIndex) -> Self
evidence.observation: Collection accessors, consuming builder, fallible iterator collection and parse/format tests. Add impls also illustrate unnecessary legacy cloning.
Associated public-key/error types, feature-gated algorithm implementations, documented methods and local arithmetic exception.
Interaction capability with alternative backends. This file also contains another author's contributions, not all attributed to Ryan.

evidence.anchor: pub fn try_encode_to(data: &[u8], writable: &mut impl Write)
evidence.observation: Generic standard I/O, checked length arithmetic and u32 conversion, public contracts, wire snapshot and refusal tests.
Sync/async protocol parity test. Comments explain initialized buffer length. Overflow test allocates roughly 4 GiB and is not a pattern to copy.
Normalize borrowed representation once, return early on invalid length, transform chunks through fallible collection, explain bounded arithmetic.

evidence.anchor: # sometimes i like the logical flow of keeping things in an "else"
evidence.observation: Explicit preference underlying redundant_else allowance, plus workspace Clippy and documentation settings.
Workspace lint and dependency inheritance with optional algorithm features.
Saturation for terminal geometry. Author-owned arithmetic change checked independently in 8d3a512.
Custom secret-redacting Debug. Other fields remain visible and deserialization contains expect calls, so not a blanket security endorsement.
Known-answer vectors check private/public keys and chain codes through multiple public entry points.

evidence.anchor: pub type ProcessResult<T = ()> = Result<T, Box<dyn std::error::Error>>;
evidence.observation: Legacy boxed binary boundary with error source-chain reporting, in contrast to newer TUI errors.
Explicit operation-level dterror convention, source/location and borrowed context fields, with a top-level wrapping error.
Owning resource guard with best-effort cleanup, plus explicit fallible lifecycle methods using Ctx and with_context.
Typed effects separating key decisions from external work, including structured recovery data.
Source enums and parser, finite request timeout/read cap, typed refusal and precisely limited fallback behavior.

evidence.anchor: pub fn text(name: impl Into<String>, value: impl Into<String>) -> Self
evidence.observation: Owned input conversion for a data type; module docs explain mutation invariants and refusal semantics.
Actual binary driven through a PTY with timed waits and exported-certificate checks using gpg and sq.
Counterexample: even the newer branch retains older thiserror/from conventions outside the TUI.

history.description: Workspace lint choices and Clippy cleanup
Checked threshold arithmetic, with legacy panic handling not recommended for external input
Introduces explicit bug diagnostics for historical invariant panics, not a no-panic convention
Adds framing tests including sync/async equivalence
Newer TUI and helper hardening with behavioral tests
